title: Synthetic Nickel-Catalyzed CO2 Methanation over Alumina Supports

paragraphs.text: Earlier work by Park et al. (2022) reported that Ni/Al2O3 catalysts suffer sintering above 723 K [1].

In this study, we prepared batch Ni-Cat-BatchA (10 wt% Ni/Al2O3) and evaluated CO2 methanation at 623 K and 1.0 bar (GHSV = 12000 mL g-1 h-1). Ni-Cat-BatchA achieved 84.2% CO2 conversion and 96.5% CH4 selectivity (see Fig. 1 and Supplementary Table S1).
Using density functional theory (DFT) slab calculations (PBE functional), we found that oxygen vacancies lower the CO2 activation barrier to 0.68 eV.
